source_findings.decision: Do not substitute LA63Hd/LA63HU or another revision without a manufacturer compatibility statement. Require matching legacy source CAD or verified shared frame.
Legacy source not established; no substitution by LB63HW or LB40NN.
Advertised secondary BK AC download contained a TS250 circuit-breaker DWG. Quarantined; BK DC / UL and USP sources not substitutes.

Internal coils, contacts, motor operators and mounting parts require their own source model or a verified parent assembly/installation relationship. Parent breaker geometry must not masquerade as a standalone accessory.
Coil AC/DC, 3P/4P and 1a1b/2a2b must match. DC 1a1b STEP50308 hidden rather than linked to 2a2b price rows.
Legacy two-pole source not present in manufacturer three-dimensional archive; require exact family documentation.

completion_rule: A price row with no verified six-view variant remains supplement-required and cannot silently use a generic box or single-angle LS drawing.

manufacturer_catalogue_search.finding: Manufacturer Metasol CAD lists separate MC contactor / MC accessory / MCCB-ELCB packages, but no verified standalone six-view MT thermal-relay package was identified. Existing native 2D thermal CAD remains partial.

reviewed_unpublished_accessory_sources.finding: Manufacturer model includes two parent contactors and mounting plate. Cannot publish this as standalone AR600 geometry or count two parent bodies again in an accessory layout.
